name: wacky station mishap
guidance: Slapstick station chaos: runaway carts, dead air, props in the wrong rack, booth gear acting possessed. Vary the physical gag rumor to rumor; the wrong detail is loud and physical, not clever wordplay.

name: deadpan absurdity
guidance: Flat, matter-of-fact delivery of impossible station details: wrong inventory counts, clocks that disagree, furniture in the wrong room. No winking; the teller reports the absurd detail like a weather note.

name: petty feud
guidance: Small-stakes grudge energy: stolen mugs, hogged mics, swapped booth props, locker sabotage, parking-spot wars, gear hoarding. Keep the sting personal and ridiculous; pick a fresh petty stunt flavor each rumor.

name: bawdy
guidance: Cheeky innuendo and flirtatious hallway talk without graphic detail: closet whispers, booth-door gossip, suggestive prop mix-ups. The laugh is suggestive, not explicit.
